metadata.note: The Burlington, Cedar Rapids and Northern Railway ('the Cedar Rapids route', Burlington - Cedar Rapids - Albert Lea, with its Iowa Falls Division reaching Estherville, Watertown SD and Sioux Falls SD), its predecessor the Burlington, Cedar Rapids and Minnesota (1868-1876), and the same lines under the Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific, which leased the BCR&N in June 1902 and bought it 15 Jun 1903. Drawn from research/branches/burlington_cedar_rapids_and_northern_railway.txt in the site repo (DanielMConnolly/historical-trains), researched 2026-11-03. Before this layer the map drew no BCR&N or BCR&M route at all. Only the report's drawable spans are drawn, which keep to years a source confirms: many branches are drawn far narrower than their real service because no BCR&N public timetable was found. Rule 4 splits: BCR&M -> BCR&N at 1876 (BCR&N incorporated 27 Jun 1876; the ICC dates the conveyance 27 Jun 1878 - SOURCE CONFLICT, recorded) and BCR&N -> Rock Island at the June 1902 lease. The BCR&N's construction / leasing companies (CRIF&NW, Iowa City & Western, Cedar Rapids & Clinton, Chicago Decorah & Minnesota, Chicago & Iowa Western, Cedar Rapids Garner & Northwestern, Davenport Iowa & Dakota) never ran trains of their own and share the BCR&N colour. Other operators on this track are separate features elsewhere: the Iowa Central / M&StL over Albert Lea - Northwood - Manly (minneapolis_and_st_louis_railway.geojson) and the Twin Star Rocket over Saint Paul - Albert Lea - Manly 1945-1967 (rock_island_twin_star_rocket.geojson).
